description: Set what a document job holds and how it is mailed: the documents uploaded with hip_get_upload_target (files replaces the whole list, so keep any added with hip_add_text_document), copies and color, the mailing option (product), the US recipient and options such as a return address. Use it after hip_create_job and the uploads; a letter or postcard written with hip_set_letter or hip_set_postcard carries its own options and takes no hip_update_job. Price fields are rejected: the server computes all amounts. Returns the updated job; call hip_quote next.

files.description: the job's full list of documents, each uploaded first with hip_get_upload_target. It replaces the list already on the job; list each document once.

color.description: bw: black & white (the default); color: full color

pages.description: your page count for this document. The price uses Have It Printed's own count of the uploaded file.

size.description: paper size: US Letter (8.5x11) only; may be left out

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

options.description: optional job settings. product: how the job is mailed (the same as the product field). return_address: the US return address printed on the envelope, with name or company, line1, line2, city, state and zip; leave it out to use Have It Printed care of the buyer.

product.description: how the job is mailed; the product field does the same

return_address.description: optional: the envelope's US return address: name or company, line1, line2, city, state (2 letters) and zip

product.description: how the job is mailed. tracked_document (the default): printed and mailed flat in a rigid mailer with a free tracking number. basic_letter: up to 5 pages, one copy of each document, folded into a standard envelope and mailed First-Class, with no tracking. certified_letter: the same letter sent by Certified Mail, with a tracking number. hip_get_service_info has the prices.

country.description: US (the default); only US addresses are mailed

name.description: the person or business the mail is addressed to

name: hip_update_job
title: Set documents and recipient
